aliases: QuarkView PT825G 4MP Wi-Fi Camera with Motion Spotlight

power.method: External DC power supply (Wi-Fi does not carry power)

features: infrared and white-light colour night modes
release_notes: Specs per the official QuarkView product page (Shenzhen Kuake Trading Co., Ltd.) and its 2-/10-camera pack page; the pages state the 4MP -40W variant (the single-camera page URL mentions 8MP but no 8MP model code or spec is published), 355/90-degree pan/tilt, IP66, two-way audio, microSD up to 128GB, H.265 (pack page) and ONVIF support. RTSP is not stated and the linked PT Wi-Fi family manual documents no RTSP path, so only an ONVIF config is given. Lens, field of view, sensor, IR range, power rating and dimensions are not published. Pan/tilt Wi-Fi camera typed ptz; no optical zoom is specified.

frigate.notes: No RTSP path published; discover via ONVIF.

home_assistant.notes: The product page lists ONVIF support; the ONVIF port is not published.
